props.name: threshold
props.description: Pixels scrolled before the button appears.

props.name: target
props.description: The scrolling element. Omit to track the window.

props.name: focusTarget
props.description: Selector for the element that receives focus once back at the top — usually the skip-link target. Without this, focus stays on a button at the bottom of the page while the reader is looking at the top of it.

props.name: showProgress
props.description: Draw a ring round the button showing how far down the page the reader is.

props.name: fixed
props.description: Pin to the viewport. Turn it off to place it inside a positioned container.
